candidates.excerpt: ### Problem The registry verifies published WASM artifacts by hash and records artifact/security scan results, but it does not capture enough build provenance to allow an independent party to reproduce the artifact from source. Two WASM files can represent the same source-level contract while differing because of toolchain versions, SDK versions, compiler settings, optimization flags, or build environment differences. A matching registry hash proves artifact identity, but it does not prove how the artifact was produced or whether it can be independently rebuilt. This limits supply-chain verification for contracts published through the registry. ### Proposed solution Add optional, structured build-provenance metadata to contract publication and verification: - Rust toolchain version. - Soroban SDK version. - Stellar CLI version. - Target triple. - Build profile and optimization settings.
